Centro — Turin, Italy

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

The historic, touristic and commercial core of the city (Via Roma, Piazza Castello, the Quadrilatero Romano). Highest perceived safety at any hour, heavily patrolled and busy with people even late in the evening.

Frequently asked questions

Is Centro safe?

Wandroz currently rates Centro in Turin, Italy as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Centro safe at night?

At night, Centro is rated as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Centro a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Centro's day rating (relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Centro?

Not yet at neighbourhood level. Unlike London, this city does not currently publish an open, geolocated crime dataset at this level of detail (checked against the relevant local and national open-data portals — see the methodology page for what was checked).
